title: 第1165章 周德胜 林律师你信不信他们活的没我好第1164章 犯罪公司内部也有贪污犯
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
了解完了整个流程后，林默问道：“设计完整个系统还需要多久？”
顾川：“一个星期吧，主要工作量是处理那些烂账，要把那些烂账伪装成对应金额的洗钱项目，这活技术含量不高，但是很消耗时间。”
林默听完，心里十分清楚，一个星期已经是极速了！
这一个星期也不能白等，于是林默问道：“那你给我下一个人的信息吧，我先去接触他，看能不能再挖掘一条线路出来给君富集团设置陷阱。”
林默可不只打算利用赔偿金+洗钱来摧毁马光集团。
这判的还是太小了。
必须继续叠加罪名，直到死刑！
这时候顾川说到：“可以，不过...”
“不过什么？忘记了？”
“没有，就是他的信息很奇怪，就三行字，我写好发给。”
顾川说完几分钟后，文件就发送过来了。
林默打开，里面还真就只有几行字。
【周德胜，君富电子厂高级工程师，工龄十二年。离职原因：严重违规操作。补偿金：三个月工资。】
“就这么点？”
“是的，我确信我当初看到他信息的时候就看到这几行字。”顾川非常肯定的说道。
林默点点头：“那行，你去忙吧，我们这边好好研究一下。”
接着双方就结束了通话。
而魏音这边拿到周德胜信息的第一时间就去查了。
“林主任，已经查到了，周德胜离职后就去了一家通讯行业的外企担任工程师，他这个级别工资应该不低。”
说着魏音就把周德胜的资料全部拿到了林默的面前。

扫了一遍。
林默眯了眯眼睛。
周德胜的情况看上去十分正常，但细看之下又非常不正常。
因为违规被开除后，反而入职了工资更高的外企。
有这种违规履历还能入职外企？
林默第一时间推测是君富集团的安抚政策。
周德胜知道什么内情，君富集团给了他两个选择。
第一个悄无声息的消失，第二个就是送去外企的高福利，等于是封口费。
或者是正常的第三种，安个罪名，拿最少的钱赶出门，然后从系统里消失。
无论如何，这人身上绝对有料可以挖。
不然不可能上那份名单。
不过目前为止，那份名单到底是干什么的，林默也不知道。
那么多人都在名单上，是待清理名单？
林默摇摇头。
没再多想，林默直接按照资料上的电话打了过去。
很快就接通了。
“喂？你是谁，为什么知道我这个电话？”警惕的声音传了出来。
资料上记录了周德胜的三个电话。
其中有一个标记为绝对隐私电话，林默打的就是这个。
林默的想法也很简单，既然是绝对隐私了，那周德胜肯定接。

林默也不墨迹直接自报家门：“周先生您好，我是顺和律所的林默律师，打电话给你是想跟你了解一下君富集团那边的事。”
“哦？林默？我认识你，君富集团？行吧，明天你来我的厂里找我，既然你能查到我这个电话，那你应该知道我在哪工作，好了我要加班了，再见。”
content_en:
After understanding the entire process, Lin Mo asked: "How long will it take to design the entire system?"
Gu Chuan: "About a week. The main workload is to deal with the bad debts and disguise them as money laundering projects with corresponding amounts. This job is not very technical, but it is very time-consuming."
After listening to this, Lin Mo knew very well that one week was already extremely fast!
This week can't be waited in vain, so Lin Mo asked: "Then give me the next person's information. I will contact him first to see if I can dig another route to set a trap for Junfu Group."
Lin Mo not only intends to use compensation + money laundering to destroy Ma Guang Group.
This judgment is still too small.
The charges must continue to be piled up until the death penalty!
At this time, Gu Chuan said: "Okay, but..."
"But what? Forgot?"
"No, it's just that his message is very strange. It's just three lines. I'll write it and send it to you."
A few minutes after Gu Chuan finished speaking, the file was sent.
Lin Mo opened it, and there were really only a few lines of words inside.
[Zhou Desheng, senior engineer at Junfu Electronics Factory, with 12 years of service. Reason for resignation: serious violation of regulations. Compensation: three months' salary. 】
"That's it?"
"Yes, I'm sure I saw these lines when I saw his message." Gu Chuan said with certainty.
Lin Mo nodded: "Okay, go ahead and do some research. Let's study it carefully here."
Then the two parties ended the call.
Wei Yin checked it as soon as he got Zhou Desheng's information.
"Director Lin, we have found out that after Zhou Desheng resigned, he went to work as an engineer in a foreign company in the communications industry. His salary at this level should not be low."
With that said, Wei Yin brought all Zhou Desheng's information in front of Lin Mo.
Scanned it again.
Lin Mo narrowed his eyes.
Zhou Desheng's situation looks very normal, but upon closer inspection, it is very abnormal.
After being fired for violating the rules, he joined a foreign company with a higher salary.
Can I still get a job at a foreign company with such a record of violations?
Lin Mo immediately speculated that it was the appeasement policy of Junfu Group.
Zhou Desheng knew what was going on, and Junfu Group gave him two choices.
The first one disappeared quietly, and the second one was given high benefits to foreign companies, which is equivalent to hush money.
Or the normal third type, where you are charged with a crime, kicked out with the minimum amount of money, and then disappear from the system.
No matter what, there is definitely something to be mined from this man.
Otherwise it would be impossible to be on that list.
But so far, Lin Mo doesn't know what that list is for.
There are so many people on the list, is it a list to be cleared?
Lin Mo shook his head.
Without thinking any more, Lin Mo directly called the number listed in the information.
The call was quickly connected.
"Hello? Who are you and why do you know my phone number?" A vigilant voice came out.
The data recorded three phone calls from Zhou Desheng.
One of the calls was marked as absolutely private, and this was the one Lin Mo made.
Lin Mo's idea was also very simple. Since it was absolutely private, Zhou Desheng would definitely accept it.
Lin Mo directly introduced himself without any ink: "Hello Mr. Zhou, I am lawyer Lin Mo from Shunhe Law Firm. I am calling you to find out about Junfu Group."
"Oh? Lin Mo? I know you, Junfu Group? Okay, come to my factory tomorrow to find me. Since you can find my phone number, you should know where I work. Okay, I have to work overtime. Goodbye."
